lede: (five figures from the listings, each photographed with the bench tool that takes it, each printed on a ruler. a reading, not a promise.)
idea: The plan said The Making, but Naira's pieces are surgical steel and plating, not lost-wax and a file, and a set that implied a jeweller's bench would be a lie. So the bench became a place where things are measured rather than made. Five cards, five figures the listings already carry: the inner diameter of a fixed-size ring, the width of a hoop, a stone and its halo, the weight of a chain, the drop of a charm. Each is drawn on an SVG ruler with the value marked in oxblood, and each is photographed with the instrument that reads it: mandrel, calliper, loupe, wax, graph paper.
type: A mono label line in oxblood, then the noun in Velista at 132px (THE SIZE. THE WIDTH. THE STONE. THE WEIGHT. THE DROP.), then the ruler: 1.5px baseline, ticks every unit, numbers every five, a marker with the figure in Jost 600. A Cormorant italic aside under it. The foot carries the listing spec, the price and the CTA.
review: Pass 1: the ink top bar vanished on the two dark bench plates; a one-unit stud earring from another listing was visible at the corner of the loupe card's story crop; the set's label class collided with the top bar's and turned the corner label oxblood; the story spec on the clover card wrapped. Pass 2: ivory bars on the mandrel and calliper cards, the loupe story plate re-cut to exclude the stud, the class renamed, the spec shortened.
verdict: run the hoops and the chain at spend; the ring, the band and the clover set are three, three and five units and belong in organic until the stock moves.

M1.title: THE SIZE.
M1.why: The chevron ring on a brass mandrel. A fixed-size ring lives or dies on one number, so the card prints the number: 17.3mm inside, US 7.
M1.source: The Bench campaign frame B01 from earlier in the engagement, re-cut.
M1.check: US 7, 17.3mm inner diameter and 9.5mm at the chevron on JDR0303312-7; 5 units, non-hero card.

M2.title: THE WIDTH.
M2.why: The braided hoop in the jaws of a vernier calliper, the reading the listing gives: 25mm across.

M3.title: THE STONE.
M3.why: The halo band under a loupe, two markers on one ruler: the 8mm stone and the 12mm cushion halo around it.
M3.source: The Bench frame B02, cropped so the neighbouring stud (one unit, not listable) is out of frame in both formats.
M3.check: 8mm round, 12mm halo, US 7 on WR10170K7; 3 units, the floor for a non-hero card.

M4.title: THE WEIGHT.
M4.why: The paperclip chain has been drawn across soft wax and left a channel. Twelve grams, shown as a mark rather than a scale readout.
M4.source: Archive frame #626 from the wax series, full resolution.

M5.title: THE DROP.
M5.why: The clover huggie on engineering graph paper, two markers: the 8.5mm drop and the 10.2mm huggie.
M5.check: 10.2mm huggie and 8.5mm drop on JDE0201327; 3 units, non-hero card.
